text.p: Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert has appointed a new chief of cabinet, Claude Chene, and a new merger aide, Olivier Guersent.

Chene, who replaces Michel Vanden Abeele from January 15, leaves a post as director of the air transport unit in the Transport Directorate General (DGVII). He served in Van Miert's cabinet during his first term as competition commissioner.

His appointment comes as the Commission is trying to gain a greater say in international talks on "open skies" agreements between the European Union and the United States and in vetting major transatlantic airline alliances such as that between British Airways and American Airlines.
Vanden Abeele becomes director general of DGXXIII (Enterprise Policy, Distributive Trades, Tourism and Cooperatives).
Guersent, who has already replaced Philippe Renaudiere, had been administrator in Directorate A of the Competition Directorate General (DGIV).
Renaudiere is now head of unit "Free movement of people and citizens' rights" in DGXV (Internal Market and Financial Services).
In DGIV, Enrique Lopez Veiga, in charge of unit two of the merger task force, is expected to leave to join the cabinet of the European Parliament president.
